title: trifolium repens var. macrorrhizum
intro: Trifolium repens var. macrorrhizum, commonly known as the long-rooted white clover, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium repens var. macrorrhizum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
